topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I can't believe I found this. It's a time capsule, right in my backyard, and I have no idea how it got there. The writing on it is faded, almost illegible, but it's old, really old. Part of me wants to open it, to see what’s inside, but another part is just... holding back. It feels wrong, like I’d be invading someone else’s past. But what if it holds answers to questions I don’t even know I have? I need to know who put it there and why. I've already started digging, almost feverishly, but I can't stop now. What if I don’t like what I find? What if it changes everything?
